title: Sensory Integration Versus Fine Motor Intervention in Children With Autism
brief_summary: Clinically, infants with Autism spectrum often display gross motor delays in supine, prone, and sitting skills in their first year of life.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ranges from 8 to 12 years.
* Mild to moderate autistic features

Exclusion Criteria:

• Significant visual or auditory defects.
